title: Ordinary World
title_zh: 平凡的世界
summary_en: A realist novel reflecting the lives, struggles, and dreams of ordinary people in China's reform era.
summary_zh: 一部现实主义作品，描写改革年代普通人的生活、奋斗与理想。
best_quote_en: Even in the most ordinary life, there is a shining strength.
best_quote_zh: 即使是平凡的生活，也有闪光的力量。

title: Awakening of Cognition
title_zh: 认知觉醒
summary_en: A book on how to improve cognition, optimize habits, and achieve personal growth.
summary_zh: 一本探讨如何提升认知、优化习惯，实现自我成长的作品。
best_quote_en: Cognition determines destiny; the higher your perspective, the farther you can go.
best_quote_zh: 认知决定命运，站得越高，看得越远。

title: The Little Prince
title_zh: 小王子
source: 安托万·德·圣-埃克苏佩里
summary_en: A poetic fable about a young prince exploring the universe and discovering love, loneliness, and meaning.
summary_zh: 一部诗意的寓言，讲述小王子探索宇宙，发现爱、孤独与意义的故事。
best_quote_en: What is essential is invisible to the eye.
best_quote_zh: 真正重要的东西，用眼睛是看不见的。

title: Destiny
title_zh: 命运
summary_en: A novel that weaves family stories and fate, reflecting the struggles of ordinary people.
summary_zh: 一部交织家庭故事与命运的小说，展现普通人的挣扎与生命张力。
best_quote_en: Fate is like the tide, sometimes pushing us forward, sometimes pulling us back.
best_quote_zh: 命运如潮，有时推着我们前进，有时把我们拉回。

title: One Sentence Worth Ten Thousand
title_zh: 一句顶一万句
summary_en: A novel about the difficulty of communication and the loneliness of individuals in modern society.
summary_zh: 一部描写沟通困境与现代人孤独的小说。
best_quote_en: People talk endlessly, but only one sentence truly hits the heart.
best_quote_zh: 人们说了一万句废话，可能只有一句说到心里。

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
title_zh: 百年孤独
source: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯
summary_en: A masterpiece of magical realism, narrating the rise and fall of the Buendía family over a century.
summary_zh: 魔幻现实主义经典，讲述布恩迪亚家族百年的兴衰史。
best_quote_en: Many years later, as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendía was to remember that distant afternoon when his father took him to discover ice.
best_quote_zh: 多年以后，奥雷连诺上校站在行刑队面前，必将想起父亲带他去见识冰块的那个遥远的下午。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-11
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-11
summary_en: Latest AI advancements in reasoning capabilities, system optimizations, model releases, and scaling infrastructure developments.
summary_zh: AI推理能力前沿进展、系统优化、模型发布及规模基础设施发展。
best_quote_en: Base models already contain reasoning mechanisms; 'thinking models' learn when to invoke them.
best_quote_zh: 基础模型已经包含推理机制；'思维模型'学习的是何时调用这些机制。

title: New AI-powered features help you connect with web content in Search and Discover.
title_zh: 全新AI功能助您在搜索和发现中连接网络内容
summary_en: Google introduces AI-powered features in Search and Discover to help users find trending content and sports updates.
summary_zh: 谷歌在搜索和发现中推出AI功能，帮助用户获取趋势内容和体育更新。
best_quote_en: Our testing shows this makes it easier to catch up on stories from a wide range of publishers and creators.
best_quote_zh: 我们的测试表明，这让用户更容易了解来自各种发布者和创作者的故事。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-10
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-10
summary_en: Comprehensive AI development update covering humanoid robots, open-source models, developer tools, benchmarks, and performance optimizations.
summary_zh: AI开发者日报全面报道人形机器人、开源模型、开发工具和性能优化进展。
best_quote_en: The video contains no remote control content, positioning F.03 for Helix, home, and global scale applications.
best_quote_zh: 影片中没有任何内容是远程操控的，将F.03定位为面向Helix、家庭和全球规模化应用。

title: Nano Banana is coming to Google Search, NotebookLM and Photos.
title_zh: Nano Banana 即将登陆 Google 搜索、NotebookLM 和相册
summary_en: Google is expanding its Nano Banana AI image editing tool from Gemini to Search, NotebookLM, and Photos for creative visual transformations.
summary_zh: 谷歌将Nano Banana AI图像编辑工具从Gemini扩展到搜索、NotebookLM和相册，用于创意视觉转换。
best_quote_en: Now, we’re bringing Nano Banana to Google Search and NotebookLM (and soon to Photos), helping more people access these advanced capabilities in products where they’re already exploring, learning and creating with visuals.
best_quote_zh: 现在，我们将Nano Banana引入Google搜索和NotebookLM（并很快引入相册），帮助更多人在他们已经在探索、学习和创造视觉内容的产品中访问这些先进功能。

title: Haberman reveals why Trump attacked judge and his family in speech
title_zh: 哈伯曼揭示特朗普为何在演讲中攻击法官及其家人
summary_en: Maggie Haberman explains Trump's motivations for attacking the judge and his family after his arraignment.
summary_zh: 哈伯曼解释特朗普在提审后攻击法官及其家人的动机。
best_quote_en: Haberman explains the reasoning behind Donald Trump's attacks on the judge and his family.
best_quote_zh: 哈伯曼解释特朗普攻击法官及其家人的背后原因。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-09
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-09
summary_en: Daily AI developer report covering micro reasoning models, JEPA density estimation, multi-modal systems, and agent infrastructure advancements.
summary_zh: AI开发者日报涵盖微型推理模型、JEPA密度估计和多模态系统与智能体基础设施进展。
best_quote_en: Less is more: fewer layers improve generalization (4→2 layers: Sudoku from 79.5% to 87.4%)
best_quote_zh: 少即是多：更少的层数改善了泛化能力（4层→2层：数独任务从79.5%提升至87.4%）

title: How to edit images with Nano Banana in Search
title_zh: 如何在搜索中使用 Nano Banana 编辑图片
summary_en: Google introduces Nano Banana in Search via Lens and AI Mode for instant image editing and creation.
summary_zh: 谷歌在搜索中推出Nano Banana，通过Lens和AI模式实现即时图片编辑和创作。
best_quote_en: Ready to unleash your imagination and have a whole bunch of fun with photos?
best_quote_zh: 准备好释放你的想象力，在照片中享受一整串的乐趣了吗？

title: Syrian refugee elected mayor of German town, years after fleeing war
title_zh: 叙利亚难民当选德国小镇镇长，数年前逃离战争
summary_en: A Syrian refugee who fled war in 2015 was elected mayor of a German town, demonstrating successful integration and political participation.
summary_zh: 一名2015年逃离战争的叙利亚难民当选德国小镇镇长，展现了成功的融合与政治参与。
best_quote_en: "Today, Ostelsheim sent an example for broad-mindedness and cosmopolitanism for the whole of Germany."
best_quote_zh: "今天，奥斯特尔斯海姆为整个德国树立了开放思想和世界主义的榜样。"

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-07
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-07
summary_en: OpenAI DevDay announces major platform updates including Apps SDK, AgentKit, GPT-5 Pro, Sora 2 APIs, and new model releases with significant price reductions.
summary_zh: OpenAI开发者大会发布应用SDK、AgentKit、GPT-5 Pro和Sora 2 API，并推出多款新模型及大幅降价。
best_quote_en: OpenAI is turning ChatGPT into an app platform with Apps SDK enabling interactive applications directly within ChatGPT.
best_quote_zh: OpenAI正将ChatGPT转变为应用平台，Apps SDK让合作伙伴能将完整交互应用直接嵌入ChatGPT。

title: Video Overviews on NotebookLM get a major upgrade with Nano Banana
title_zh: NotebookLM 的视频概述功能通过 Nano Banana 实现重大升级
summary_en: NotebookLM upgrades Video Overviews with Nano Banana's image generation and adds a Brief format for quick insights.
summary_zh: NotebookLM 视频概述通过 Nano Banana 图像生成升级，新增快速摘要格式。
best_quote_en: Nano Banana in NotebookLM generates helpful, contextual, and beautiful illustrations based on the sources you upload.
best_quote_zh: Nano Banana 在 NotebookLM 中根据您上传的源文件生成有用、上下文相关且美观的插图。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-15
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-15
summary_en: Daily AI developer update covering hardware comparisons, new frameworks, model benchmarks, and infrastructure innovations in machine learning.
summary_zh: 涵盖硬件对比、新框架发布、模型基准测试和机器学习基础设施创新的AI开发者日报。
best_quote_en: The world needs more compute power - OpenAI leadership on 10 GW custom accelerator partnership with Broadcom.
best_quote_zh: 世界需要更多算力——OpenAI领导层就与博通的10吉瓦定制加速器合作发表评论。

title: Introducing Veo 3.1 and advanced capabilities in Flow
title_zh: 介绍 Veo 3.1 和 Flow 中的高级功能
summary_en: Google DeepMind introduces Veo 3.1 with enhanced audio, narrative control, and editing tools for AI video creation in Flow.
summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Veo 3.1，增强音频、叙事控制和编辑工具，提升 AI 视频创作体验。
best_quote_en: With more precise editing capabilities, audio across all existing features and higher-quality outputs powered by Veo 3.1, we're opening up new possibilities for richer, more powerful video storytelling.
best_quote_zh: 凭借更精确的编辑功能、所有现有功能的音频支持以及由 Veo 3.1 驱动的高质量输出，我们正在为更丰富、更强大的视频叙事开辟新的可能性。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-06
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-06
summary_en: Comprehensive AI development update covering coding agents, video generation, robotics, and reinforcement learning with latest model rankings and breakthroughs.
summary_zh: 全面AI开发更新，涵盖编程智能体、视频生成、机器人和强化学习，包含最新模型排名与突破。
best_quote_en: "Terence Tao publicly documented using GPT-5 with tool functions to find counterexamples and heuristics in mathematics."
best_quote_zh: "陶哲轩公开记录使用 GPT-5 结合工具功能在数学中寻找反例和启发式方法。

title: How a Gemma model helped discover a new potential cancer therapy pathway
title_zh: Gemma模型如何帮助发现新的潜在癌症治疗途径
summary_en: A 27-billion parameter AI model identified a novel cancer therapy pathway by discovering synergistic drug effects, validated through lab experiments.
summary_zh: 一个270亿参数的AI模型通过发现协同药物效应识别出新的癌症治疗途径，并通过实验验证。
best_quote_en: The model predicted a strong increase in antigen presentation when silmitasertib was applied in the 'immune-context-positive' setting, but little to no effect in the 'immune-context-neutral' one.
best_quote_zh: 模型预测在'免疫环境阳性'设置中应用silmitasertib会显著增加抗原呈递，但在'免疫环境中性'设置中几乎没有效果。

title: Kwame Brathwaite, photographer of 'Black is Beautiful' movement, dies at 85
title_zh: Kwame Brathwaite，'黑即是美'运动摄影师，逝世，享年85岁
summary_en: Pioneering photographer Kwame Brathwaite, who defined the 'Black is Beautiful' movement through his work celebrating Black culture and beauty, has died at 85.
summary_zh: 开拓性摄影师Kwame Brathwaite通过作品定义'黑即是美'运动，颂扬黑人文化与美，逝世享年85岁。
best_quote_en: "You want to get the feeling, the mood that you're experiencing when they're playing. That's the thing. You want to capture that."
best_quote_zh: "你想要捕捉他们演奏时的感觉和氛围。这才是关键。你想要捕捉那种感觉。"

title: Britain's pound is beating every other major currency this year
title_zh: 英国英镑今年表现优于所有其他主要货币
summary_en: The British pound has become the best-performing major currency in 2023, rebounding strongly from last year's lows due to economic resilience and interest rate expectations.
summary_zh: 英国英镑今年表现最佳，因经济韧性和加息预期从去年低点强劲反弹。
best_quote_en: Sterling hit its highest level against the US dollar in 10 months on Tuesday, topping $1.25 for the first time since June 2022.
best_quote_zh: 英镑周二兑美元汇率创下10个月新高，自2022年6月以来首次突破1.25美元。

title: 10 ways you can ask Google Photos to edit your photos for you
title_zh: 10种方法让Google Photos帮你编辑照片
summary_en: Google Photos now allows users to edit images through conversational prompts, offering 10 creative examples for AI-powered photo enhancements.
summary_zh: Google Photos现可通过对话指令编辑照片，提供10种AI增强创意示例。
best_quote_en: It's easier than ever to edit your images in Google Photos — all you have to do is ask.
best_quote_zh: 在Google Photos中编辑图像比以往任何时候都更容易——你只需要开口要求。

title: The four astronauts NASA picked for the first crewed moon mission in 50 years
title_zh: NASA挑选四名宇航员执行50年来首次载人登月任务
summary_en: NASA reveals the four astronauts selected for Artemis II, the first crewed moon mission since 1972.
summary_zh: NASA公布四名宇航员，将执行50年来首次载人绕月飞行任务。
best_quote_en: "It's so much more than the four names that have been announced... It is the next step in the journey that will get humanity to Mars."
best_quote_zh: “这远不止是公布的四个名字……这是将人类送上火星之旅的下一步。”

title: AI Mode is now available in more languages and locations around the world.
title_zh: AI 模式现已在全球更多语言和地区推出
summary_en: Google Search expands AI Mode to 35+ languages and 40+ countries, powered by Gemini models for natural language understanding.
summary_zh: 谷歌搜索 AI 模式新增 35 种语言和 40 个国家，由 Gemini 模型驱动实现自然语言理解。
best_quote_en: The advanced reasoning and multimodal understanding of our custom Gemini model allows AI Mode to truly grasp the subtleties of local languages.
best_quote_zh: 我们定制 Gemini 模型的高级推理和多模态理解使 AI 模式能真正掌握本地语言的细微差别。

title: These are the animals people most want to see photographed
title_zh: 人们最希望拍摄到的动物
summary_en: The New Big 5 photography book showcases endangered wildlife through stunning images to raise conservation awareness.
summary_zh: 《新五大动物》摄影书通过精美图片展示濒危野生动物，旨在提高环保意识。
best_quote_en: "We have a window of time during which we can start to heal some of the harm we have inflicted on the natural world, but only if we get together and take action now."
best_quote_zh: "我们有一个时间窗口可以开始修复我们对自然世界造成的伤害，但前提是我们必须立即团结起来采取行动。"

title: 10 years of genomics research at Google
title_zh: 谷歌基因组研究的十年历程
summary_en: Google's decade-long genomics research used AI to improve DNA sequencing accuracy and develop tools for healthcare and biodiversity applications.
summary_zh: 谷歌十年基因组研究利用AI提升DNA测序精度并开发医疗和生物多样性工具。
best_quote_en: The advancement of genomics over the past decade comes down to our approach to creating an innovation flywheel: we are driven by a real-world problem to conduct fundamental computer science research.
best_quote_zh: 过去十年基因组学的进步归功于我们创建创新飞轮的方法：我们被现实世界问题驱动进行基础计算机科学研究。

title: DeepSomatic, an open-source AI model, is speeding up genetic analysis for cancer research.
title_zh: DeepSomatic，一个开源AI模型，正在加速癌症研究的基因分析
summary_en: DeepSomatic uses AI to accurately identify cancer-driving genetic variants, outperforming current methods and accelerating global research.
summary_zh: DeepSomatic利用AI精确识别癌症驱动基因变异，超越现有方法，加速全球癌症研究。
best_quote_en: The tool is proven to outperform current methods at spotting these key variants, particularly insertions and deletions.
best_quote_zh: 该工具被证明在检测这些关键变异（特别是插入和删除）方面优于现有方法。

title: 2023 March Madness: Will UConn or San Diego State triumph in the national championship game that 'means everything?'
title_zh: 2023年疯狂三月：康涅狄格大学还是圣地亚哥州立大学将在全国冠军赛中胜出？
summary_en: UConn defeated San Diego State 76-59 to win its fifth men's basketball national championship title.
summary_zh: 康涅狄格大学以76-59战胜圣地亚哥州立大学，赢得第五个男子篮球全国冠军。
best_quote_en: "We knew we were the best team in the tournament going in and we just had to play to our level," said UConn coach Dan Hurley.
best_quote_zh: 康涅狄格大学教练丹·赫尔利表示：“我们知道自己是锦标赛中最强的球队，只需打出我们的水平。”

title: Investing in America 2025
title_zh: 投资美国 2025
summary_en: Google announces major US investments in AI infrastructure, workforce development, and energy capacity to advance American innovation and economic growth.
summary_zh: 谷歌宣布在美国大规模投资AI基础设施、劳动力发展和能源容量，以推动美国创新和经济增长。
best_quote_en: Through major investments in technical infrastructure, research and development — along with expanded energy capacity for an AI-driven economy and workforce development and education programs — we will help the U.S. continue to lead the world in AI.
best_quote_zh: 通过对技术基础设施、研发的重大投资，以及为AI驱动经济扩展能源容量和劳动力发展与教育计划，我们将帮助美国继续在AI领域引领世界。

title: Beijing promised to 'fight back' over Taiwan leader's US visit. But this time it has more to lose
title_zh: 北京承诺对台湾领导人访美'坚决回击'，但这次损失可能更大
summary_en: China faces strategic constraints in responding to Tsai-McCarthy meeting amid global tensions and Taiwan's upcoming election.
summary_zh: 中国在全球局势紧张和台湾选举前对蔡麦会面回应面临战略制约。
best_quote_en: "This puts the burden on China not to overreact, because any overreaction is only going to push China further away from the world," said Yun Sun, director of the China Program at the Stimson Center think tank in Washington.
best_quote_zh: 华盛顿智库史汀生中心中国项目主任孙韵表示：“这给中国带来了不要反应过度的负担，因为任何过度反应只会让中国离世界更远。”

title: Introducing the Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model
title_zh: Gemini 2.5 计算机使用模型发布
summary_en: Google releases Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model enabling AI agents to interact with user interfaces via API.
summary_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 2.5 计算机使用模型，通过 API 实现 AI 代理与用户界面交互。
best_quote_en: The ability to natively fill out forms, manipulate interactive elements and operate behind logins is a crucial next step in building powerful, general-purpose agents.
best_quote_zh: 原生填写表单、操作交互元素并在登录后工作的能力是构建强大通用代理的关键下一步。

title: Micron Technology: China probes US chip maker for cybersecurity risks as tech tension escalates
title_zh: 美光科技：中国调查美国芯片制造商网络安全风险，科技紧张局势升级
summary_en: China launches cybersecurity probe into Micron Technology amid escalating tech tensions with US and allies over semiconductor restrictions.
summary_zh: 中国对美光科技启动网络安全审查，美中科技紧张局势因半导体限制升级。
best_quote_en: The move is aimed at ensuring the security of key information infrastructure supply chains, preventing cybersecurity risks, and maintaining national security.
best_quote_zh: 此举旨在保障关键信息基础设施供应链安全，防范网络安全风险，维护国家安全。

title: Google AI Plus is coming to 36 more countries.
title_zh: Google AI Plus 即将登陆 36 个新国家
summary_en: Google AI Plus expands to 36 more countries, offering enhanced AI features and a limited-time 50% discount for new subscribers.
summary_zh: Google AI Plus 扩展至 36 个国家，提供增强 AI 功能和限时 50% 新用户折扣。
best_quote_en: Google AI Plus is our new plan designed to help people do more with the latest Google AI models and features, for less.
best_quote_zh: Google AI Plus 是我们的新计划，旨在帮助人们以更低成本利用最新的 Google AI 模型和功能做更多事情。

title: What OPEC's surprise oil cut means for gas prices
title_zh: OPEC意外减产对汽油价格意味着什么
summary_en: OPEC+'s surprise oil production cut will raise US gas prices and reignite inflation concerns.
summary_zh: OPEC+意外减产将推高美国汽油价格并重燃通胀担忧。
best_quote_en: "I think OPEC is reawakening the inflation monster. The White House has to be shocked and major-time pissed."
best_quote_zh: "我认为OPEC正在重新唤醒通胀怪兽。白宫肯定感到震惊且极度愤怒。"

title: Googler Michel Devoret awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics
title_zh: 谷歌员工 Michel Devoret 获诺贝尔物理学奖
summary_en: Google Quantum AI scientist Michel Devoret wins 2025 Nobel Prize for foundational work enabling modern superconducting quantum computing.
summary_zh: 谷歌量子AI科学家因奠定超导量子计算基础的突破性研究获2025年诺贝尔物理学奖。
best_quote_en: They proved that quantum mechanics could be revealed and controlled in a macroscopic electrical circuit on a chip.
best_quote_zh: 他们证明了量子力学可以在芯片上的宏观电路中显现并受控。

title: Video shows moment of deadly explosion at cafe in Russia
title_zh: 视频显示俄罗斯咖啡馆致命爆炸瞬间
summary_en: A video captures the explosion that killed Russian military blogger Vladlen Tatarsky in a St. Petersburg cafe.
summary_zh: 视频记录俄罗斯军事博主在圣彼得堡咖啡馆爆炸中丧生的瞬间。
best_quote_en: A well-known Russian military blogger, Vladlen Tatarsky, was killed in an explosion at a cafe in St. Petersburg, authorities said.
best_quote_zh: 当局称，知名俄罗斯军事博主弗拉登·塔塔尔斯基在圣彼得堡一家咖啡馆的爆炸中丧生。

title: Dogecoin jumps after Elon Musk replaces Twitter bird with Shiba Inu
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克将推特鸟标志换成柴犬后狗狗币大涨
summary_en: Elon Musk replaced Twitter's bird logo with a Shiba Inu, causing Dogecoin prices to surge over 20% amid ongoing legal challenges.
summary_zh: 马斯克将推特鸟标换成柴犬，狗狗币价格飙升超20%，正值法律诉讼期间。
best_quote_en: The doge logo appeared two days after Musk asked a judge to throw out a $258 billion racketeering lawsuit accusing him of running a pyramid scheme to support dogecoin.
best_quote_zh: 柴犬标志出现两天前，马斯克要求法官驳回指控他运营支持狗狗币金字塔骗局的2580亿美元敲诈勒索诉讼。

title: Musk's Twitter promised a purge of blue check marks. Instead he singled out the New York Times
title_zh: 马斯克的推特承诺清理蓝V认证，却单独针对《纽约时报》
summary_en: Twitter under Musk selectively removed the New York Times' verification while sparing most legacy checkmarks, creating platform confusion.
summary_zh: 马斯克的推特单独取消《纽约时报》认证而保留多数蓝V，凸显平台政策混乱。
best_quote_en: It also highlights how Musk often appears to guide decisions about the platform more by whims than by policy.
best_quote_zh: 这也突显出马斯克似乎经常凭一时兴起而非政策来指导平台决策。

title: A new approach to a Covid-19 nasal vaccine shows early promise
title_zh: 新冠鼻腔疫苗新方法初显成效
summary_en: German scientists develop a nasal COVID-19 vaccine achieving sterilizing immunity in animal studies by blocking virus replication in airways.
summary_zh: 德国科学家研发出鼻腔新冠疫苗，在动物实验中通过阻断病毒在呼吸道复制实现灭菌免疫。
best_quote_en: "If they are already on site, they can immediately eliminate the fire, but if they’re like 2 miles away, they first need to drive there, and by that time, one-third of the house is already in full flames," Wyler said.
best_quote_zh: “如果消防员已经在现场，他们可以立即灭火，但如果他们在两英里外，他们需要先开车过去，到那时房子三分之一已经燃起大火，”维勒说。

title: Angel Reese defends gesture directed towards Caitlin Clark after LSU national title win; calls out double standard after being 'unapologetically' her
title_zh: 安吉尔·里斯在LSU全国冠军赛后为对凯特琳·克拉克的手势辩护；在被'毫无歉意地'做自己后指出双重标准
summary_en: LSU's Angel Reese defends her championship game gesture toward Caitlin Clark, highlighting racial double standards in sports reactions.
summary_zh: LSU球员安吉尔·里斯为决赛手势辩护，指出体育界对不同种族运动员的评判存在双重标准。
best_quote_en: "All year, I was critiqued for who I was. I don't fit the narrative. I don't fit the box that y'all want me to be in."
best_quote_zh: "一整年，我因为做自己而受到批评。我不符合你们想要我成为的样子，不符合你们的叙事框架。"

title: Study finds slightly higher risk of autism diagnosis in areas with more lithium in drinking water, but experts say more research is needed
title_zh: 研究发现饮用水中锂含量较高地区自闭症诊断风险略高，但专家表示需更多研究
summary_en: A study finds a modest association between higher lithium levels in drinking water and autism risk, though causation remains unproven and requires further research.
summary_zh: 研究发现饮用水中锂含量与自闭症风险存在微弱关联，但因果关系未证实，需进一步研究。
best_quote_en: "Any drinking water contaminants that may affect the developing human brain deserve intense scrutiny," said study co-author Dr. Beate Ritz.
best_quote_zh: 研究合著者Beate Ritz博士表示：“任何可能影响发育中人脑的饮用水污染物都值得密切关注。”

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-12-04
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-12-04
summary_en: AI developers report major advances in video generation, model releases, agent infrastructure, and benchmark developments across multiple AI domains.
summary_zh: AI开发者日报报道视频生成、模型发布、智能体基础设施和基准测试等多领域重大进展。
best_quote_en: Kling 2.6 model can generate videos with synchronized voice, sound effects and ambient audio in one go, achieving excellent audiovisual coordination.
best_quote_zh: Kling全新的2.6模型能够一次性生成视频并同步生成语音、音效和环境音效，具备出色的'视听协调性'。

title: Look back on your 2025 with Google Photos Recap
title_zh: 用 Google Photos Recap 回顾你的 2025 年
summary_en: Google Photos Recap returns for 2025 with enhanced personalization and sharing features including CapCut integration and WhatsApp sharing.
summary_zh: Google Photos Recap 2025 版推出，新增个性化编辑和社交分享功能。
best_quote_en: This year, we've added new ways for you to personalize, create and share your Recap.
best_quote_zh: 今年我们增加了新的方式，让您可以个性化、创建和分享您的回顾。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-12-02
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-12-02
summary_en: Daily AI development report covering major model releases, technical innovations, and community insights across the AI ecosystem.
summary_zh: AI开发者日报，涵盖主要模型发布、技术创新和AI生态系统社区动态。
best_quote_en: The router is becoming the de facto multi-supplier abstraction layer for AI applications, but SRE-style reliability and transparency are now top priorities.
best_quote_zh: 路由器正在成为AI应用事实上的多供应商抽象层，但SRE风格的可靠性和透明度现在已成为首要关注点。

title: We’re announcing new health AI funding, while a new report signals a turning point for health in Europe.
title_zh: 我们宣布新的健康人工智能资助，同时新报告显示欧洲健康领域迎来转折点
summary_en: Google announced $5M funding for AI healthcare solutions in Europe and released a report showing AI is reversing slowing scientific productivity.
summary_zh: 谷歌宣布500万美元资助欧洲AI医疗解决方案，报告显示AI正扭转科学生产力下降趋势。
best_quote_en: AI is reversing the long-term trend of slowing scientific productivity, providing a turning point for a European healthcare system grappling with rising costs and workforce shortages.
best_quote_zh: 人工智能正在扭转科学生产力长期放缓的趋势，为应对成本上升和劳动力短缺的欧洲医疗体系提供了转折点。

title: Israeli military veterans, a backbone of protest movement, vow to keep demonstrating
title_zh: 以色列退伍军人成为抗议运动中坚力量，誓言继续示威
summary_en: Israeli military veterans are leading ongoing protests against judicial reforms, using military organizational skills to defend democracy.
summary_zh: 以色列退伍军人运用军事组织技能领导抗议司法改革，誓言捍卫民主制度。
best_quote_en: "We believe this is our responsibility to go once again called to the flag of the nation to stop this madness to defend Israel,"
best_quote_zh: “我们相信这是我们的责任，再次响应国家号召，阻止这种疯狂，保卫以色列。”

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-11-28
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-11-28
summary_en: Comprehensive AI development updates covering persistent agents, Claude Opus 4.5 performance, multimodal generation breakthroughs, and production deployment insights.
summary_zh: 涵盖持久智能体、Claude Opus 4.5性能评估、多模态生成突破和生产部署洞察的AI开发者综合动态。
best_quote_en: LatentMAS replaces text messages with compact latent vectors between agents, reducing communication tokens by ~70-84% while improving accuracy by up to +4.6% on 9 benchmarks.
best_quote_zh: LatentMAS用紧凑的潜在向量替代智能体间的文本消息，通信令牌减少约70-84%，同时在9个基准测试中准确率提高高达+4.6%。

title: We’re celebrating Geoffrey Hinton’s Nobel-winning legacy with the University of Toronto.
title_zh: 我们与多伦多大学共同庆祝杰弗里·辛顿的诺贝尔奖遗产
summary_en: Google invests $10 million CAD to establish the Hinton AI Chair at University of Toronto, honoring Geoffrey Hinton's neural network legacy.
summary_zh: 谷歌投资1000万加元在多伦多大学设立辛顿人工智能教席，致敬杰弗里·辛顿的神经网络遗产。
best_quote_en: This chair honors his legacy and will help the university recruit visionary scholars dedicated to the same kind of curiosity-driven, fundamental research that Geoff championed.
best_quote_zh: 这个教席旨在纪念他的遗产，并将帮助大学招募致力于与杰夫所倡导的同样类型的好奇心驱动的基础研究的远见卓识的学者。

title: Shania Twain calls for equal pay and more diversity in country music
title_zh: 仙妮亚·唐恩呼吁乡村音乐界实现同工同酬和更多多样性
summary_en: Shania Twain advocates for equity and diversity in country music, highlighting inclusive actions and trailblazing efforts.
summary_zh: 仙妮亚·唐恩在CMT颁奖礼上呼吁乡村音乐界实现平等与多样性，支持包容性行动。
best_quote_en: "Together, let’s ensure all our fellow artists get equal play regardless of gender, age or race."
best_quote_zh: “让我们一起确保所有艺术家，无论性别、年龄或种族，都能获得平等的展示机会。”

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-11-27
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-11-27
summary_en: AI Developer Daily covers major model releases like Claude Opus 4.5 and FLUX.2, benchmark performance analysis, and ecosystem developments in AI research and applications.
summary_zh: AI开发者日报涵盖Claude Opus 4.5和FLUX.2等主要模型发布、基准性能分析以及AI研究和应用生态发展。
best_quote_en: The era of scaling is over; we are returning to an era of research focused on deployment-time continual learning, value functions regulated by emotions, and model serrations rather than raw scale.
best_quote_zh: 规模化时代已经结束；我们正回归研究时代，重点关注部署时持续学习、情绪调节的价值函数以及模型锯齿性而非原始规模。

title: Use Circle to Search and Google Lens to spot scam messages.
title_zh: 使用 Circle to Search 和 Google Lens 识别诈骗信息
summary_en: Google's Circle to Search and Lens now help detect scam messages using AI analysis and web data.
summary_zh: 谷歌 Circle to Search 和 Lens 新增功能，利用 AI 和网络数据帮助识别诈骗信息。
best_quote_en: Our systems will use AI and information from the web to assess whether the message is likely a scam.
best_quote_zh: 我们的系统将利用 AI 和网络信息来评估信息是否可能是诈骗。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-12-05
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-12-05
summary_en: AI developer daily covering Google's Gemini 3 Deep Think reasoning model, programming frameworks, AI agent safety, and latest model benchmarks.
summary_zh: AI开发者日报涵盖Google Gemini 3 Deep Think推理模型、编程框架、AI智能体安全和最新模型基准测试。
best_quote_en: "Agent scaffolding is as important as the model itself," highlighting the critical role of infrastructure in production AI systems.
best_quote_zh: "智能体脚手架与模型同等重要"，凸显了基础设施在生产AI系统中的关键作用。

title: Gemini 3 and Nano Banana Pro in Search are coming to more countries around the world.
title_zh: Gemini 3 和 Nano Banana Pro 在搜索中即将登陆全球更多国家
summary_en: Google expands Gemini 3 and Nano Banana Pro AI models to nearly 120 countries, offering advanced reasoning and multimodal capabilities.
summary_zh: 谷歌将 Gemini 3 和 Nano Banana Pro AI 模型扩展至近 120 个国家，提供高级推理和多模态功能。
best_quote_en: AI Mode can grasp the nuance of your most complex queries with Gemini 3's state-of-the-art reasoning capabilities.
best_quote_zh: 借助 Gemini 3 最先进的推理能力，AI 模式能够理解您最复杂查询的细微差别。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-11-26
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-11-26
summary_en: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.5 with major cost reductions and performance gains, while AMD-native ZAYA1 and new diffusion RL methods push AI boundaries.
summary_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Opus 4.5，成本降低3倍性能提升，AMD原生模型和新扩散RL方法突破AI边界。
best_quote_en: "At medium effort, Opus 4.5 beats Sonnet 4.5 on SWE-bench Verified while using 76% fewer output tokens."
best_quote_zh: 在"中等effort"下，Opus 4.5在SWE-bench Verified上击败了Sonnet 4.5，同时使用了76%更少的输出token。

title: Here’s how researchers in Asia-Pacific are using AlphaFold
title_zh: 亚太研究人员如何运用AlphaFold
summary_en: Researchers in Asia-Pacific use AlphaFold AI to advance disease treatment and biological discovery through protein structure prediction.
summary_zh: 亚太研究人员利用AlphaFold AI预测蛋白质结构，推动疾病治疗和生物学发现。
best_quote_en: "AlphaFold is like the internet for structural biology."
best_quote_zh: "AlphaFold就像结构生物学的互联网。"

title: What pet cemeteries reveal about being human
title_zh: 宠物墓地揭示的人类本质
summary_en: Archaeological analysis of pet cemeteries reveals evolving human-animal relationships and changing mourning practices across centuries.
summary_zh: 考古研究揭示宠物墓地反映人类与动物关系演变及哀悼方式的变迁。
best_quote_en: Like the burial of people, the burial of pets is an intimate cultural practice, one that changes over time and is reflective of the changing relationships that a society has with its cherished creatures.
best_quote_zh: 如同人类葬礼一样，宠物葬礼是一种亲密的文化习俗，它随时间变化，反映社会与其珍爱动物关系的演变。

title: Erdogan's political fate may be determined by Turkey's Kurds
title_zh: 埃尔多安的政治命运可能由土耳其的库尔德人决定
summary_en: Turkey's pro-Kurdish HDP party emerges as kingmaker in upcoming elections, potentially unseating President Erdogan after decades in power.
summary_zh: 土耳其亲库尔德政党成为选举关键力量，可能终结埃尔多安二十年统治。
best_quote_en: We are facing a turning point that will shape the future of Turkey and (its) society... we will not field a presidential candidate in (the) May 14 elections.
best_quote_zh: 我们正面临塑造土耳其及其社会未来的转折点……我们不会在5月14日选举中推出自己的总统候选人。

title: Get an in-depth look at Gemini 3 with CEO Sundar Pichai.
title_zh: 与CEO Sundar Pichai深入探讨Gemini 3
summary_en: Google CEO Sundar Pichai discusses AI-first strategy and future quantum computing bets in podcast interview.
summary_zh: 谷歌CEO在播客中分享AI优先战略及量子计算等长期投资展望。
best_quote_en: I think in about five years we'll be having breathless excitement about quantum, hopefully, like we are having with AI today.
best_quote_zh: 我认为大约五年后，我们将对量子计算充满无比兴奋，就像今天我们对AI一样。

title: Chelsea searches for new manager as Premier League breaks record for most sackings in a single season
title_zh: 切尔西寻找新主帅，英超创下单赛季解雇教练最多纪录
summary_en: Chelsea fired Graham Potter after poor results despite massive spending, setting a Premier League record for most managerial sackings in a season.
summary_zh: 切尔西解雇主帅波特，创下英超单赛季解雇教练最多纪录。
best_quote_en: "You don't change Tuchel for Potter. Ridiculous decision to start with."
best_quote_zh: "你不该用波特换掉图赫尔。从一开始就是个荒谬的决定。"

title: The Google guide for holiday help
title_zh: 谷歌假日助手指南
summary_en: Google's guide uses AI tools like Gemini and Maps to simplify holiday shopping, planning, and hosting tasks.
summary_zh: 谷歌指南利用Gemini和地图等AI工具简化假日购物、规划和招待任务。
best_quote_en: Offload tedious tasks to Gemini, get insider recommendations from Google Maps and be sure you're getting the best price when shopping on Google.
best_quote_zh: 将繁琐任务交给Gemini处理，从Google地图获取内部推荐，并确保在谷歌购物时获得最优价格。

title: 4 ways to refine your content in Flow
title_zh: 4种在Flow中优化内容的方法
summary_en: Google Flow introduces four new AI-powered editing features for enhanced creative control over image and video content.
summary_zh: 谷歌Flow推出四项AI编辑功能，提升图像和视频内容的创意控制能力。
best_quote_en: Instead of wordsmithing the perfect prompt, you can draw or annotate on an image, Flow understands your doodles and incorporates them into your final frame.
best_quote_zh: 无需绞尽脑汁编写完美提示词，您可以直接在图像上绘制或标注，Flow能够理解您的涂鸦并将其融入最终画面。

title: The latest AI news we announced in November
title_zh: 谷歌11月AI新闻汇总
summary_en: Google announced major AI updates including Gemini 3 launch, Nano Banana Pro, and $40 billion infrastructure investment in November.
summary_zh: 谷歌11月发布多项AI更新，包括Gemini 3、Nano Banana Pro和400亿美元基础设施投资。
best_quote_en: The distance between a spark of imagination and reality has never been shorter.
best_quote_zh: 想象力与现实之间的距离从未如此接近。

title: New research from Google Workspace reveals how young leaders are using AI at work.
title_zh: Google Workspace新研究揭示年轻职场领导者如何使用AI
summary_en: Google research shows young leaders use AI for personalized responses, workflow automation, and professional confidence building.
summary_zh: Google研究显示年轻领导者通过AI实现个性化响应、工作流自动化和专业信心提升。
best_quote_en: Young leaders want AI that offers more personalized responses — think outputs that aren't just generic, but use your preferred tone and style.
best_quote_zh: 年轻领导者希望AI提供更个性化的响应——输出内容不仅通用，还要使用您偏好的语气和风格。

title: Gemini 3 Pro: the frontier of vision AI
title_zh: Gemini 3 Pro: 视觉AI的前沿
summary_en: Gemini 3 Pro delivers state-of-the-art multimodal AI performance across document, spatial, screen and video understanding with advanced reasoning capabilities.
summary_zh: Gemini 3 Pro在文档、空间、屏幕和视频理解方面提供最先进的多模态AI性能和高级推理能力。
best_quote_en: Gemini 3 Pro represents a generational leap from simple recognition to true visual and spatial reasoning.
best_quote_zh: Gemini 3 Pro代表了从简单识别到真正视觉和空间推理的世代飞跃。

title: Suspected Chinese spy balloon was able to transmit information back to Beijing
title_zh: 疑似中国间谍气球能够将信息传回北京
summary_en: The Chinese spy balloon that transited the US captured imagery and collected signals intelligence from military sites, transmitting data back to Beijing in real time.
summary_zh: 穿越美国的中国间谍气球能够从军事基地捕获图像并收集信号情报，实时将数据传回北京。
best_quote_en: The balloon was able to transmit information back to Beijing in real time, and the US government still does not know for sure whether the Chinese government could wipe the balloon's data as it received it.
best_quote_zh: 气球能够实时将信息传回北京，美国政府仍不确定中国政府是否能够在接收数据时擦除气球的数据。

title: 3 things to know about Ironwood, our latest TPU
title_zh: 关于我们最新 TPU Ironwood 的三点了解
summary_en: Google's seventh-gen Ironwood TPU delivers 4x performance gains and energy efficiency for AI inference and model serving at scale.
summary_zh: 谷歌第七代Ironwood TPU为AI推理和模型服务提供4倍性能提升和能源效率。
best_quote_en: Ironwood is our most powerful, capable, and energy-efficient TPU yet, designed to power thinking, inferential AI models at scale.
best_quote_zh: Ironwood是我们迄今为止最强大、能力最强、能效最高的TPU，专为大规模思维推理AI模型设计。

title: This boiled bag of offal is banned in the US. In Scotland it's a fine-dining treat
title_zh: 这种煮熟的杂碎袋在美国被禁，在苏格兰却是精致美食
summary_en: Haggis, Scotland's national dish made from sheep organs and oatmeal, is banned in the US but remains a beloved culinary tradition with modern adaptations.
summary_zh: 苏格兰国菜哈吉斯由羊杂碎和燕麦制成，在美国被禁但在本土备受喜爱并发展出现代创新。
best_quote_en: "It's like a cuddle for the stomach," says Nicola Turner, a 35-year-old office administrator from Helensburgh.
best_quote_zh: “就像给胃一个拥抱，”来自苏格兰海伦斯堡的35岁办公室管理员尼古拉·特纳说道。

title: 16 Google AI tips for stress-free holiday hosting in 2025
title_zh: 2025年无压力假日聚会的16个Google AI技巧
summary_en: Google's AI tools help plan parties, cook food, take photos, and solve problems for stress-free holiday hosting.
summary_zh: Google AI工具可协助聚会策划、烹饪、拍照和问题解决，实现无压力假日招待。
best_quote_en: You don't have to go it alone - plenty of Google AI tools can make the process easier and more fun.
best_quote_zh: 您不必独自承担——众多Google AI工具能让整个过程更轻松有趣。

title: HSBC's top execs face tense shareholders calling for a breakup
title_zh: 汇丰银行高管面临紧张股东要求分拆银行的呼声
summary_en: HSBC executives defended their unified strategy against shareholder pressure to spin off the profitable Asian business at a tense Hong Kong meeting.
summary_zh: 汇丰高管在香港股东会议上为统一战略辩护，抵制分拆亚洲业务的压力。
best_quote_en: "It would not be in your interest to split the bank," HSBC Chairman Mark Tucker told shareholders.
best_quote_zh: 汇丰董事长马克·塔克告诉股东：“分拆银行不符合你们的利益。”

title: Develop a deeper understanding with interactive images in Gemini.
title_zh: 通过 Gemini 互动图像深化理解
summary_en: Gemini introduces interactive images for active visual exploration of complex academic concepts.
summary_zh: Gemini推出互动图像功能，支持主动探索复杂学术概念。
best_quote_en: Gemini is transforming studying from passive viewing into active exploration.
best_quote_zh: Gemini正在将学习从被动观看转变为主动探索。

title: Giving Marjorie Taylor Greene a platform isn't good for America
title_zh: 为玛乔丽·泰勒·格林提供平台对美国不利
summary_en: CNN opinion piece argues that giving Marjorie Taylor Greene media platforms legitimizes extremism despite being profitable for networks.
summary_zh: CNN评论认为媒体为玛乔丽·泰勒·格林提供平台会合法化极端主义，尽管能为电视台带来利润。
best_quote_en: "Moonves may be gone from CBS, but it appears his mindset continues at '60 Minutes.' And that may be good for '60 Minutes,' but it's definitely not good for America."
best_quote_zh: 穆恩维斯可能已离开CBS，但他的心态似乎在《60分钟》节目中延续。这对《60分钟》或许是好事，但对美国绝对不是。

title: How we’re bringing AI image verification to the Gemini app
title_zh: 我们如何将AI图像验证引入Gemini应用
summary_en: Google introduces AI image verification in Gemini using SynthID watermarking to detect AI-generated content and plans expansion to video/audio formats.
summary_zh: 谷歌在Gemini应用中推出AI图像验证功能，使用SynthID水印检测AI生成内容，并计划扩展到视频和音频格式。
best_quote_en: We are increasing content transparency by introducing the ability to verify if an image was generated or edited by Google AI right in the Gemini app.
best_quote_zh: 我们通过在Gemini应用中直接引入验证图像是否由谷歌AI生成或编辑的功能来增强内容透明度。

title: Build with Nano Banana Pro, our Gemini 3 Pro Image model
title_zh: 使用Nano Banana Pro构建，我们的Gemini 3 Pro图像模型
summary_en: Google releases Gemini 3 Pro Image model for developers with advanced image generation, editing capabilities, and professional controls.
summary_zh: 谷歌发布Gemini 3 Pro图像模型，为开发者提供先进的图像生成、编辑功能及专业控制。
best_quote_en: This state-of-the-art image generation and editing model unlocks high-fidelity images with higher accuracy in text rendering and robust world knowledge.
best_quote_zh: 这种最先进的图像生成和编辑模型解锁了高保真图像，具有更高的文本渲染准确性和强大的世界知识。

title: Introducing Nano Banana Pro
title_zh: Nano Banana Pro 简介
summary_en: Google DeepMind launches Nano Banana Pro, an advanced image generation model with superior text rendering and creative controls.
summary_zh: 谷歌DeepMind推出Nano Banana Pro，具备多语言文本生成和高级创意控制功能。
best_quote_en: Built on Gemini 3 Pro, Nano Banana Pro uses Gemini's state-of-the-art reasoning and real-world knowledge to visualize information better than ever before.
best_quote_zh: 基于Gemini 3 Pro构建，Nano Banana Pro利用Gemini的最先进推理和现实世界知识，以前所未有的方式可视化信息。

title: Teenage swimmer breaks two world records in four days
title_zh: 少女游泳选手四天内打破两项世界纪录

summary_zh: 16岁游泳选手麦金托什四天内两破世界纪录，展现卓越竞技水平。
best_quote_en: "That's the first time I really vividly heard the crowd during my race," McIntosh said.
best_quote_zh: 麦金托什表示："这是我第一次在比赛中如此清晰地听到观众的欢呼声。"

title: How Westinghouse is reenergizing nuclear power with — and for — AI
title_zh: 西屋电气如何利用人工智能并为其重新激活核能
summary_en: Westinghouse partners with Google Cloud to deploy AI systems that accelerate nuclear reactor construction, optimize operations, and enhance safety protocols.
summary_zh: 西屋电气与谷歌云合作，利用人工智能加速核反应堆建设并优化运营安全。
best_quote_en: "energy for AI and AI for energy" - Dr. Lou Martinez Sancho, Westinghouse CTO
best_quote_zh: “为AI提供能源，用AI优化能源” - 西屋电气首席技术官 Lou Martinez Sancho 博士

title: 'Scary, cold, hungry and lonely': Volunteer soldier shares experience on front line
title_zh: ‘可怕、寒冷、饥饿和孤独’：志愿兵分享前线经历
summary_en: A volunteer soldier shares his traumatic frontline experiences during the Russia-Ukraine conflict and discusses mental health impacts.
summary_zh: 一名志愿兵分享俄乌冲突前线创伤经历及其对心理健康的影响。

best_quote_zh: ‘可怕、寒冷、饥饿和孤独’：志愿兵分享前线经历

title: At our Research@ Poland event we shared how AI is helping us solve big challenges.
title_zh: 在波兰Research@活动上我们分享了AI如何帮助我们解决重大挑战
summary_en: Google Research demonstrates how real-world challenges drive AI research breakthroughs through global collaboration across health, disaster response, and scientific discovery.
summary_zh: 谷歌研究展示现实挑战如何推动AI突破，通过全球合作应对健康、灾害响应和科学发现。
best_quote_en: "The magic cycle — where real-world challenges drive foundational research and scientific breakthroughs."
best_quote_zh: “魔法循环——现实世界的挑战推动基础研究和科学突破。”

title: French minister under fire for Playboy magazine cover
title_zh: 法国部长因《花花公子》封面照引发争议
summary_en: French minister Marlene Schiappa faces criticism from her own party for appearing on Playboy cover during pension reform crisis.
summary_zh: 法国部长因在养老金改革危机期间登上《花花公子》封面而遭党内批评。
best_quote_en: Defending the right of women to have control of their bodies, that's everywhere and all the time. In France, women are free.
best_quote_zh: 捍卫女性对自己身体的控制权，这是无处不在且无时不刻的。在法国，女性是自由的。

title: China Renaissance suspends trading, delays results after founder's disappearance
title_zh: 华兴资本暂停交易，创始人失联后延迟公布业绩
summary_en: China Renaissance suspends trading and delays results due to founder Bao Fan's disappearance since February.
summary_zh: 华兴资本因创始人包凡失联而暂停交易并延迟公布年度业绩。
best_quote_en: Shares in China Renaissance have plunged since Bao went missing, at one point dropping as much as 50%.
best_quote_zh: 自包凡失联以来，华兴资本股价暴跌，一度下跌高达50%。

title: CEOs are tired of being held responsible for gun regulation
title_zh: CEO们厌倦为枪支管制负责
summary_en: CEOs express frustration at being expected to lead social change alone on gun regulation.
summary_zh: CEO们对独自承担枪支管制社会变革责任表示厌倦。
best_quote_en: "CEOs are just one group of people and it's like we're turning to them to be our saviors on every topic."
best_quote_zh: CEO们只是人群中的一部分，但我们似乎把他们当成了解决所有问题的救世主。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-12-08
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-12-08
summary_en: Daily AI developer update covering inference infrastructure, multimodal models, agent platforms, open-source tools, and hardware advancements.
summary_zh: AI开发者日报：涵盖推理基础设施、多模态模型、智能体平台、开源工具和硬件进展的最新动态。
best_quote_en: Inference models now account for over 50% of OpenRouter usage, with Chinese-trained closed-source models driving most traffic.
best_quote_zh: 推理模型现在占OpenRouter使用量的50%以上，中国训练的闭源模型推动了大部分流量。

title: Some fans whistle as Lionel Messi's name is announced as Paris Saint-Germain's season hits new low
title_zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼赛季陷入新低谷，梅西名字播报时遭球迷嘘声
summary_en: PSG's disappointing season worsens as fans whistle at Messi despite his strong individual performance.
summary_zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼赛季表现糟糕，球迷对梅西报以嘘声，尽管他个人数据出色。
best_quote_en: Paris' problem is when the No. 1 objective of the Champions League is no longer accessible, it seems that the season no longer exists – and at all levels.
best_quote_zh: 巴黎的问题是当欧冠这个首要目标无法实现时，整个赛季似乎就失去了意义——在各个层面都是如此。

title: Finland's Prime Minister Sanna Marin concedes election
title_zh: 芬兰总理桑娜·马林承认选举失利
summary_en: Finland's left-wing Prime Minister Sanna Marin conceded defeat as the right-wing opposition party won parliamentary elections amid economic concerns.
summary_zh: 芬兰左翼总理马林承认选举失利，右翼反对党在经济担忧中赢得议会选举。
best_quote_en: We got the biggest mandate. I will fix Finland and its economy.
best_quote_zh: 我们获得了最大的授权。我将修复芬兰及其经济。

title: Video shows moment man throws yogurt on two women in Iran
title_zh: 视频显示伊朗男子向两名女性泼酸奶
summary_en: A man throws yogurt at two unveiled women in an Iranian store, highlighting ongoing tensions over women's rights.
summary_zh: 伊朗男子向未戴头巾的女性泼酸奶，反映女性权利冲突。
best_quote_en: Video shows an incident at a store in the Iranian city of Shandiz where a man approached two unveiled women before proceeding to grab a tub of yogurt from the store and throw it, hitting both women in the head.
best_quote_zh: 视频显示伊朗沙迪兹市一家商店发生的事件，一名男子接近两名未戴头巾的女性，然后从商店抓起一桶酸奶扔向她们，击中了两人的头部。

title: Why did Finland's PM lose? Reporter explains the key issue voters cared about
title_zh: 芬兰总理为何落选？记者解释选民最关心的问题
summary_en: Analysis of Finland's election defeat reveals voters prioritized economic concerns over Sanna Marin's popularity.
summary_zh: 芬兰选举分析显示选民更关注经济问题而非总理个人魅力。
best_quote_en: Finland's left-wing Prime Minister Sanna Marin conceded defeat in the country's parliamentary election as the opposition right-wing National Coalition Party claimed victory in a tightly fought contest.
best_quote_zh: 芬兰左翼总理桑娜·马林承认在议会选举中失败，反对党右翼国家联合党在激烈竞争中获胜。

title: Emma Heming Willis shares family photos as daughter Mabel turns 11
title_zh: 艾玛·海明·威利斯分享家庭照片庆祝女儿梅布尔11岁生日
summary_en: Emma Heming Willis celebrates daughter Mabel's 11th birthday with nostalgic family photos while raising awareness about Bruce Willis' frontotemporal dementia.
summary_zh: 艾玛·海明·威利斯分享家庭照片庆祝女儿11岁生日，同时提高对布鲁斯·威利斯额颞叶痴呆症的认识。
best_quote_en: "Your energy is infectious," she continued, praising her little girl for the way she "can light a whole room with your smile and warmth."
best_quote_zh: “你的能量具有感染力，”她继续说道，称赞她的小女儿“能用你的微笑和温暖点亮整个房间。”

title: Lawmaker speaks out about his struggle with depression
title_zh: 议员公开谈论他与抑郁症的斗争

summary_zh: 参议员费特曼在胜选后公开谈论个人抑郁症经历。
best_quote_en: Sen. John Fetterman (D-PA) spoke to CBS about battling with depression after winning a tight election.
best_quote_zh: 参议员约翰·费特曼向CBS讲述了他在赢得激烈选举后与抑郁症斗争的经历。

title: Man rides out tornado inside van. See the footage
title_zh: 男子在货车内经历龙卷风 观看现场视频

best_quote_zh: 科迪·库姆斯讲述了他在阿肯色州小石城龙卷风中，于害虫防治货车内幸存的经历。

title: See 'Star Wars' legend react to Acosta's Darth Vader impression

best_quote_zh: "演员马克·哈米尔加入CNN的吉姆·阿科斯塔节目，讨论关于他传奇的《星球大战》角色卢克·天行者潜在衍生剧的想法。"

title: How we’re supporting the next generation of innovators

summary_en: Google is launching AI Quests for AI literacy in schools and providing over $5 million in funding for computer science education during Computer Science Education Week.
summary_zh: 谷歌在计算机科学教育周推出AI探索游戏并资助500多万美元，以提升学校AI素养和计算机科学教育。
best_quote_en: While coding tasks may change in the AI era, the foundational principles of computer science remain more vital than ever.
best_quote_zh: 在AI时代，编程任务可能会发生变化，但计算机科学的基础原则比以往任何时候都更加重要。

title_zh: 通过负责任的AI合作改变北欧教室
summary_en: Google partners with Nordic educators to integrate AI tools responsibly in classrooms, enhancing personalized learning and teacher efficiency.
summary_zh: 谷歌与北欧教育者合作，负责任地将AI工具融入课堂，提升个性化学习和教师效率。

title: READ: Trump indictment related to hush money payment
title_zh: 阅读：特朗普与封口费支付相关的起诉书

title: Russian authorities detain suspect over St. Petersburg cafe blast
title_zh: 俄罗斯当局拘留圣彼得堡咖啡馆爆炸案嫌疑人
summary_en: Russian authorities detained a female suspect in the St. Petersburg cafe explosion that killed a military blogger, amid ongoing Ukraine conflict developments.
summary_zh: 俄罗斯拘留圣彼得堡咖啡馆爆炸案女嫌疑人，同时乌克兰冲突持续发展。

best_quote_zh: 一名女性嫌疑人因周日圣彼得堡咖啡馆爆炸事件被拘留，该事件导致一名著名俄罗斯军事博主死亡。

title: Hundreds of millions at risk from Chinese shopping app malware
title_zh: 中国购物应用恶意软件危及数亿用户
summary_en: Pinduoduo shopping app contains sophisticated malware exploiting Android vulnerabilities to spy on users and competitors.
summary_zh: 拼多多购物应用含恶意软件，利用安卓漏洞监控用户和竞争对手活动。
best_quote_en: "We haven't seen a mainstream app like this trying to escalate their privileges to gain access to things that they're not supposed to gain access to."
